name: Sunday School
description: Stories, songs and snacks for ages three to eleven, in the classrooms off the hall.

name: Youth Group
description: Pizza, honest questions and a service project each month for grades six to twelve.

name: The Choir
description: No audition, just a willingness to learn the tenor line. Robes provided.

name: Food Pantry
description: Groceries for around two hundred neighbors a week, packed and handed out by volunteers.

name: Home Groups
description: Eight to ten people, a living room and a kettle — scattered across town most weeknights.
